elimnote: Shown only when no combination of results and tiebreakers could save the team — a spot still reachable via a points-for tiebreak counts as alive.
brinknote: On the brink: those results leave no path to the playoffs without winning a points-for tiebreak. The percentage is the team's playoff odds across 100,000 simulations if the loss happens; under 1% counts as effectively out.

paths.text: Even winning out only gets Sam to 7-7 — and the path needs the middle to collapse: Martin (7-4) can't win again; Cliff (7-4) can't win again; Clancy (6-5) can win at most 1 more; Steve (6-5) can win at most 1 more; Mark (5-6) can win at most 2 more. That leaves a 6-way tie at 7-7 for the last 3 spots. The tie crosses divisions, so it falls to season points-for: Sam (1176.4) must out-score 3 of the 5 — at minimum overtaking Mark, currently 46.4 points ahead. Simulated odds: 1.0%.
